The people behind the magic

Meet our team

The VIBES Drama team brings together seasoned theatre practitioners and corporate professionals who are passionate about transforming workplace behavior — one performance at a time.

Founder & Director

Jayanth VM

Founder Director · Vibes Drama

Jayanth VM is the Founder and Director of Vibes Drama, a pioneering drama-based behavioral training organization that leverages the power of theatre to create meaningful and lasting learning experiences. With a unique blend of corporate experience, training and theatre expertise, Jayanth has dedicated his career to helping individuals and organizations transform behaviors, strengthen workplace relationships, and build high-performing teams through experiential learning.

Before founding Vibes Drama, Jayanth spent over 15 years with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), where he held a variety of leadership roles including Client Relationship Manager, Solution Architect, Team Lead, Mentor, and Trainer. Working closely with clients across the United States, Europe, and Singapore, he gained deep insights into organizational dynamics, leadership challenges, and the behavioral competencies required for success in modern workplaces.

A passionate theatre practitioner for over 20 years, Jayanth has written, directed, and performed in numerous theatre productions across public platforms and corporate settings. His belief that people learn best when they experience, reflect, and emotionally connect with a message led him to combine theatre with workplace learning. Since 2018, he has been designing and facilitating drama-based behavioral interventions that make complex human and organizational challenges relatable, engaging, and actionable.

A certified corporate trainer from the Indian Academy of Training & Development (IATD), Jayanth has trained and facilitated learning programs for more than 20,000 professionals across 50+ leading organizations. His expertise spans Leadership development, DEI, POSH, Ownership and accountability, Emotional intelligence, Teamwork, Effective Communication, Customer centricity, and Culture transformation.

At Vibes Drama, Jayanth's mission is simple yet powerful: to make learning memorable, meaningful, and transformative by bringing real workplace behavioral challenges to life through the art of drama.

The team

Lead Facilitators

Our lead facilitators are trained theatre practitioners and behavioral learning experts who bring every session to life.

Mohan Madgulkar

Lead Facilitator

Mohan Madgulkar is a highly accomplished Learning & Development professional with over three decades of experience in Human Resources, organizational development, and workplace learning. A Post Graduate in Personnel Management from the University of Pune, he has held senior leadership roles across manufacturing, insurance, and telecommunications sectors, bringing deep business insight and people expertise to every engagement.

In 2007, Mohan founded Shivalik Consultants, a workplace learning and performance improvement firm that has successfully partnered with industrial organizations, healthcare institutions, public sector enterprises, and educational establishments. His passion for experiential learning led him to the field of drama-based development in 2010, when he established the India operations of Steps Drama Learning Development, UK. Since then, he has been at the forefront of introducing and popularizing drama-based learning interventions across India and the broader South Asian region.

Over the years, Mohan has designed and delivered impactful learning experiences for more than 100 leading Indian and multinational organizations. His work has taken him beyond India to facilitate programs for global audiences in the United Kingdom, Hungary, Sweden, Türkiye, the United Arab Emirates, and Poland. Known for his engaging facilitation style, he combines business acumen, behavioral science, and experiential methodologies to create meaningful and lasting learning outcomes.

Mohan's professional credentials include certifications in Creative Training Techniques (Bob Pike Group, USA), Assessment Centres (XLRI Jamshedpur), Thomas Profiling, and the Basic Lab on Human Processes from the Indian Society of Applied Behavioural Sciences (ISABS). He also serves as a Visiting Faculty at the Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune, where he teaches Human Resource Management to postgraduate students, shaping the next generation of HR leaders.

Dr Roopa Hariani

Lead Facilitator

Dr. Roopa Hariani is a distinguished Behavioral Specialist, Corporate Trainer, Leadership Mentor and Dental Surgeon with over three decades of professional excellence. By blending the precision of a medical professional with a deep understanding of human psychology, she delivers high-impact behavioral and soft-skills training programs that transform corporate cultures and empower leadership teams.

Expertise & Behavioral Specialization

  • ›Master Trainer: Holds a Master Diploma in Training from the Indian Academy of Training and Development (IATD).
  • ›Corporate Alchemist: Specializes in leadership mentoring, emotional intelligence, impactful communication, and motivational speaking.
  • ›Compliance Expert: Certified POSH and POCSO enabler, guiding organizations to build safe, inclusive, and legally compliant workplaces.

Social Work & Community Leadership

  • ›Statutory Leadership: Serves as a Council Member for the Karnataka Anti-Sexual Harassment Council of WICCI (Women's Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industry).
  • ›Civic Impact: Past President of the Inner Wheel Club of Bangalore Southwest, spearheading large-scale community development and welfare projects.
  • ›Rotarian: Active member dedicated to driving impactful social change and local community empowerment.

Clinical Background

  • ›Seasoned Surgeon: A practicing Dental Surgeon since 1995 (BDS, M.R. Ambedkar Dental College) and active Indian Dental Association member, bringing 31+ years of analytical problem-solving and clinical empathy to her corporate audience.

Vishal Mahesh

Lead Facilitator

Vishal Mahesh is a multifaceted personality with a strong and vibrant stage presence. A Certified Trainer, Toastmaster, Theatre Artist and passionate Tennis Player, he handles every role with consummate ease.

He has twice been the President of LA1924 — Bangalore's most popular and oldest Toastmasters Public Speaking club — and has won many awards and accolades for public speaking excellence.

Vishal is part of various theatre groups and has performed all over Bangalore. He has also ventured into filmmaking, co-producing and acting in various short films short listed for film festivals.

He makes learning more meaningful and mindful with everyday examples, relatable topics, quotes, thoughts, and a clear communication style.

Vishal strongly believes in the mantra: "Count your life by smiles not tears, count your age by friends not years."

Kasturi Manohar

Lead Facilitator

Kasturi stands at the intersection of theatre, entrepreneurship, and empowerment. With over a decade of experience in theatre and performance, she has harnessed the power of storytelling to inspire confidence, courage, and meaningful transformation.

As a seasoned actress and facilitator with Vibes Drama, Kasturi has been part of numerous stage performances and drama-based learning interventions, particularly in the areas of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DE&I) for corporates and educational institutions. Her ability to bring complex human experiences to life through performance creates powerful moments of reflection, learning, and dialogue, helping individuals discover their voice, embrace their strengths, and unlock their full potential.

Beyond the stage, Kasturi is a passionate advocate for women's empowerment and workplace equity. As a mother of two who has navigated the challenges of balancing professional ambitions with personal responsibilities, she brings authenticity, empathy, and practical insight to conversations around inclusion and equal opportunity. Her own experiences have deepened her understanding of the unique barriers faced by working mothers and women professionals, fueling her commitment to creating more equitable workplaces.

Through her work, she champions the idea that every individual deserves the opportunity to thrive, grow, and contribute without being constrained by societal expectations or systemic barriers. Her blend of lived experience, entrepreneurial spirit, and artistic expression makes her a compelling voice for empowerment and positive change.
